title: Daily Devotional #30
paragraphs: As I read through Mark 2 today, I am struck by the incredible faith of the paralyzed man's friends. They were determined to bring him to Jesus, no matter what it took. They believed that Jesus could heal their friend, and they were willing to do whatever it took to get him to Jesus.

As I reflect on this story, I am reminded of the importance of having a strong faith in you. These friends had such faith that they were willing to go to great lengths to bring their friend to you. They didn't let obstacles like a crowded house stop them from getting to you. They were persistent and determined, and because of their faith, their friend was healed.

Lord, help me to have that kind of faith. Help me to trust in you completely and to believe that you are able to do anything. When I face obstacles or challenges, help me to remember that nothing is impossible for you. Help me to be persistent and determined in my faith, just like the paralyzed man's friends.
Thank you for this powerful reminder of the importance of faith. I pray that I will continue to grow in my faith and trust in you more and more each day.
